rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for an infection in a person or the illness resulting from it.

example.english: This patient has been diagnosed with an influenza infection.
example.traditional: 呢個病人確診感染流感。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 beng6 jan4 kok3 zan2 gam2 jim5 lau4 gam2

rows.note: Use this for a named infectious disease, especially one that can spread from person to person.

example.english: Dengue fever is an infection that can spread from person to person.
example.jyutping: dang1 gaak3 jit6 hai6 jat1 zung2 cyun4 jim5 beng6

rows.note: Use this for the process or act of passing an infection from one host to another.

example.english: The flu can easily pass an infection on to your family.
example.traditional: 流感好容易傳染畀屋企人。
example.jyutping: lau4 gam2 hou2 jung4 ji6 cyun4 jim5 bei2 uk1 kei2 jan4
